Funds allocated under PMAY in
Himachal Pradesh
*16. SHRIMATI VIPLOVE
THAKUR: Will the Minister of RURAL
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) the funds allocated to Government
of Himachal Pradesh under the Pradhan
Mantri Awaas Yojana (PMAY) in the
financial years 2015-16, 2016-17 and
2017-18;
(b) the names of districts in the State
covered under the scheme; and
(c) the number of houses constructed/
likely to be constructed in Kangra district
under the scheme?
Revision of diversion of  forest land
for Mission Bhagiradha Project
*17. SHRI DHARMAPURI
SRINIVAS: Will the Minister of
ENVIRONMENT, FOREST AND
CLIMA TE CHANGE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government is in receipt of
any proposal from Telangana Government
seeking revision of diversion of forest land
for Mission Bhagiradha Project;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) whether Government has taken any
decision on the matter and if so, the details
thereof?
PMPRPY beneficiaries for textile
sector
*18. PROF. M.V . RAJEEV GOWDA:
Will the Minister of TEXTILES be pleased
to state:
(a) the number of textile sector
employees registered under Pradhan Mantri
Paridhan Rojgar Protsahan Yojana
(PMPRPY), since its inception, month-
wise;
(b) the quantum of funds disbursed under
the scheme since its inception, month-wise;

7
(c) whether it is a fact that beneficiaries
have not been able to receive their claims
due to errors in Aadhaar linkage to their
PAN numbers; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Harassment and manhandling for 
open defecation
†*19. SHRI VISHAMBHAR  
PRASAD NISHAD: Will th e Minister of  
DRINKING WATER AND SANITATION 
be pleased to state:
(a) the amount spent for promotion of  
social awareness under cleanliness drive 
during the last three years;
(b) whether incidents of manhandling 
of people defecating in open and their social 
harassmen t have come to the notice of  
Government; and
(c) the steps being taken by 
Government for creating social awareness  
in order to curb these incidents and the  
extent to which such effo rts h ave been  
fruitful?
Pollution level in Indian cities
*20. SHRI P. BHATTACHARYA: Will 
the Minister of ENVI RONMENT,  
FOREST AND CLIMATE CHANGE be  
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that a recently 
concluded study has revealed that mo st of 
the cities of the country have become  
polluted and pollution has become a life 
threatening menace;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the details of corrective measures
Government proposes to undertake to
minimise the pollution levels in the
country?
Clearance of margin money by HHEC
*21. SARDAR BALWINDER SINGH
BHUNDER: Will the Minister of
TEXTILES be pleased to refer to the
answer to Unstarred Question 1573 given
in Rajya Sabha on 1st January, 2018 and
state:
(a) the details of balance amount as per
Books of Accounts of Handicrafts and
Handlooms Exports Corporation of India
Limited (HHEC), as payable to a private
company;
(b) whether HHEC is in a very difficult
financial position and have sought the help
of the Ministry for financial support in
order to clear the Margin Money of the
company; and
(c) if so, the details thereof and by when
the blocked Margin Money would be paid
to the company?
Status of BPL card holders in the
country
*22. SHRI DEREK O’BRIEN: Will the
Minister of RURAL DEVELOPMENT be
pleased to state:
(a) the number of people in the country
having BPL cards as in 2017, Urban and
Rural-wise;
(b) the number of people who have been
added or have applied for inclusion in the
BPL category during the last three years;
(c) whether the Ministry is verifying
the previous card holders to ensure that
they still come under the criterion of BPL
and if so, the details thereof; and
(d) whether there are instances of people
availing BPL services illegally and if so, the
details thereof, along with the steps taken
to curb them?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

8
Restoration of ponds for drinking
water
†*23. SHRI MEGHRAJ JAIN: Will the
Minister of DRINKING WA TER AND
SANITA TION be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has any special
scheme for restoration of ponds, keeping
in view the problem of drinking water in
the country, if so, the details thereof;
(b) whether Government has received
suggestions in this regard from various
States, if so, the details thereof,
State-wise;
(c) the details of ponds restored during
the last three years under this scheme,
State-wise; and
(d) the details of amount spent on
restoration of ponds during the last three
years and in current year under this scheme,
year-wise?
Scrapping of Spike anti-tank guided
missiles deal
*24. SHRI AMAR SINGH: Will the
Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to
 state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
has recently scrapped a USD 500 million
deal to develop Spike anti-tank guided
missiles, and if so, the details thereof;
(b) whether it is also a fact that Spike
was selected earlier after a long and rigorous
process and complying with all the defence
procurement regulations; and
(c) if so, the specific reasons for
cancellation of the said deal?
Land acquired under Bharatmala
Project
*25. SHRI T. RATHINA VEL: Will the
Minister of ROAD TRANSPORT AND
HIGHWAYS be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that National
Highways Authority of India needs to
acquire more land for undertaking works
under Bharatmala Project which covers
24,800 km of fresh highway network,
including 800 km of Expressways;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the steps taken by NHAI to acquire
the land for the said project?
Project for manufacture of small arms
under Make in India programme
*26. DR. V . MAITREYAN: Will the
Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government had conducted
company validation procedure through our
Defence Attache in Slovakia;
(b) if so, the details thereof and current
status of the said project for manufacture
of small arms under the Make in India
programme;
(c) whether the Ordnance Factory Board
(OFB) has responded to expedite the
process;
(d) whether there is delay in according
approval to any such company, which was
approved by OFB particularly for the
manufacture of small arms under the
programme; and
(e) if so, the details thereof and the steps
taken to approve such project?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

9
FAC's recommendations on diversion
of forest
*27. SHRI MAJEED MEMON: Will
the Minister of ENVIRONMENT,
FOREST AND CLIMATE CHANGE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Forest
Advisory Committee (FAC) has
recommended 91,798 hectare area (918 sq.
km.) for diversion during the last eight
months and if so, the reasons therefor;
(b) whether Government's
Environmental Impact Survey suggested for
any alternate sites before approval of Ken-
Betwa main project which had diversion of
6,017 hectare of forest land in favour of
National Water Development Agency
(NWDA); and
(c) if so, what steps are taken by
Government to mitigate the loss of forest
and wildlife at Panna Tiger Reserve?
Contribution under Swachh Bharat
Kosh (SBK)
*28. SHRI SAMBHAJI
CHHATRAPATI: Will the Minister of
DRINKING WATER AND
SANITA TION be pleased to state:
(a) whether the objective of
Government to set up Swachh Bharat Kosh
was to mobilize resources for improving
sanitation facilities through Swachh Bharat
Mission in rural and urban areas;
(b) if so, the amount of contribution
received in 2015, 2016 and 2017 (upto
November) under SBK; and
(c) the details of projects and funds
released from SBK, year-wise?
Closure of textile hub in
Tirupur
*29. SHRI R. V AITHILINGAM: Will
the Minister of TEXTILES be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Government is aware of
fears  of complete wipeout of the
` 42,000 crore textile hub in Tirupur;
(b) whether it is a fact that many of the
units in Tirupur have been closed in the
recent past; and
(c) if so, whether Government is
considering to revive Tirupur textile hub?
Assurance on Ganga river
cleaning
*30. SHRI KAPIL SIBAL: Will the
Minister of W ATER RESOURCES,
RIVER DEVELOPMENT AND GANGA
REJUVENA TION be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that he had
confirmed that Ganga will be pollution free
by October, 2016, if so, State/city-wise
details on status of pollution in Ganga river;
(b) whether he has once again assured
that Ganga would be cleaned by 2018;
(c) whether it has now been stated that
it will take ten years to clean Ganga; and
(d) whether Government has any
concrete timeline, as to when Ganga will
finally be cleaned?

RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for WRITTEN ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on

————
(Ministries : Defence; Drinking Water and Sanitation; Earth Sciences;
Environment, Forest and Climate Change; Information and Broadcasting;
Mines; Panchayati Raj; Road Transport and Highways; Rural Development;
Science and Technology; Shipping; Textiles; Water Resources,
River Development and Ganga Rejuvenation)
Total number of questions — 160
Make in India in Defence sector
161. SHRI C.P. NARAYANAN: Will
the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to
state:
(a) which are the areas in Defence in
which Make in India has been newly
introduced;
(b) the number of products developed
by DRDO and other Indian institutions
which are being or are proposed to be mass
produced during the last three years;
(c) how many contracts the present
Government has signed to import defence
equipments and machinery;
(d) whether the existing defence
production factories are closed now or are
on their way to closure; and
(e) if so, the details thereof?
Budgetary allocation and spending on
defence modernisation
162. SHRI BHUBANESWAR
KALITA: Will the Minister of DEFENCE
be pleased to state:
(a) the details of budgetary allocation
of the Ministry during the current financial
year together with the actual spending so
far;
(b) whether it is a fact that the Ministry
has sought additional funds for defence
modernisation during the current financial
year;
(c) if so, the details of modernisation
programmes; and
(d) whether the demand for additional
funds have been met by the Ministry of
Finance?
Project of building nuclear powered
submarines
163. SHRI BHUBANESWAR
KALITA: Will the Minister of DEFENCE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the Indian
Navy has launched an ambitious project to
build  six  Nuclear-Powered  attack
submarines;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
37

38
(c) what are the other weapons that have
been procured/proposed to be procured to
strengthen the country's Naval Power?
New weapons procurement policy
164. SHRI P. BHA TTACHARY A: Will
the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Government is willing to
implement the new weapons procurement
policy;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) the details of the policies framed by
Government to have latest technologies for
development of weapons in the country;
and
(d) if so, the achievement made so far?
Achievements in Defence sector
165. SHRI P. BHA TTACHARY A: Will
the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to
state:
(a) the details of achievements made by
Government during the last three years in
Defence sector; and
(b) the details of the action plan
formulated for the next two years in this
regard?
Abolition of community based
regiments
†166. SHRI P.L. PUNIA: Will the
Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that there have
been community-based regiments in the
country since pre- independence days, if
so, the details thereof along with their
establishment and names;
(b) whether it is also a fact that many
such regiments have been abolished after
independence, if so,  the details thereof
along with the names thereof; and
(c) whether Government intends to
revive these abolished regiments and if not,
the details thereof along with the reasons
therefor?
Development of long range submarine
based missile system
167. SHRIMATI RENUKA
CHOWDHURY: W ill the Minister of
DEFENCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has any plan
to strongly develop long range submarine
based missile system;
(b) if so, the details thereof and if not,
the reasons therefor; and
(c) the steps taken by Government to
counter the emerging maritime threats in
Indian Ocean region and maintain strong
deterrence against any such threats?
Disclosure of Rafale deal agreement in
public
†168. SHRI NARESH AGRAW AL:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
does not want to disclose in public domain
the  agreement made with France about the
Rafale deal;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor; and
(c) if not, the salient features of the
Rafale deal and whether private sector,
which does not have any experience in this
field has also been included in this deal?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

39
Shortage of ammunition for armed
forces
169. SHRI VIVEK GUPTA: Will the
Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to state:
(a) the quantity of additions made to
various types of ammunitions of the armed
forces and the storages in ammunition since
2014;
(b) whether these additions to
ammunition, meet the officially sanctioned
requirement of the war wastage reserve
(WWR) of 40 days of intense war;
(c) if not, the measures taken by
Government to meet the minimum
sanctioned requirement  of ammunitions;
and
(d) the measures taken by Government
to ease the capacity constrains of ordnance
factory boards and augment their
production capacity, since 2014?
Signing of agreements with other
countries
170. SHRI K. SOMAPRASAD: Will
the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to
state:
(a) the countries with which India has
signed various agreements during the last
three years;
(b) the details of any military or defence
agreements signed with the nations during
the last three years; and
(c) the details of any private company
in India, producing military or defence
tools or equipment?
Replacement of HAL by Reliance
Defence in Rafale deal
171. SHRI D. RAJA: Will the Minister
of DEFENCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the country's
premier defence manufacturing company
Hindustan Aeronautics Ltd. (HAL) was
very much involved in the discussions,
underway with the French company along
with the Defence Ministry on the Rafale
deal, but HAL was jettisoned at the last
minute, replacing the public sector
company by Reliance Defence; and
(b) if so, the details thereof and the
reasons therefor?
Chinese road in Arunachal Pradesh
172. SHRI RIPUN BORA: Will the
Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has any report
that China has made 1.3 km. of road inside
Arunachal Pradesh;
(b) if so, what steps Government has
taken to stop China from building the road;
and
(c) if so, how road construction was
possible inspite of deployment of Indian
Army on the Indo-China border?
Increase of Chinese transgression into
Indian side of LAC
173. SHRI RIPUN BORA: Will the
Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government is aware that
there was marked increase in the number
of Chinese transgressions into the Indian
side of the Line of Actual Control (LAC)
in 2017;
(b) whether it is a fact that the Indian
and Chinese Armies were involved in a 73
day face off at Doklam on Sikkim-Bhutan
border;
(c) whether it is a fact that there were
415 transgressions by Chinese soldiers into

40
the Indian side of the LAC in 2017, as
against 271 in 2016; and
(d) if so,  how it was possible in spite
of heavy deployment of Indian Army and
close surveillance in the areas?
Designated cantonment areas in cities
and towns
174. DR. VINAY P.
SAHASRABUDDHE: Will the Minister of
DEFENCE be pleased to state:
(a) the details of cities or towns in the
country having, designated cantonment
areas;
(b) the number of cases of illegal
encroachment or land grabbing by
individuals and organizations registered
against those responsible for these cases
so far; and
(c) what is the overall State of litigations
filed against alleged culprits so far and the
total number of cases filed by the Ministry
and lost during the last three years and the
details thereof, State-wise?
Setting up of National Open Air Range
Evaluation Centre
175. SHRI T.G . VENKATESH: Will the
Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has promised
to establish National Open Air Range
Evaluation Centre at V orvakallu Village,
Kurnool district of Andhra Pradesh;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) the status of the centre as on date
and reasons for the delay; and
(d) whether Government is taking any
step to expedite the construction work of
the unit within its scheduled period for
completion and the details thereof?
Penalisation of Dassault for non-
fulfilment of contractual obligations
176. PROF. M.V . RAJEEV GOWDA:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased
to state
(a) whether Dassault was penalized for
refusing to fulfil its contractual obligations
under the Medium Multi-Role Combat
Aircraft Request for Proposal;
(b) if so, the details thereof and if not,
the reasons therefor;
(c) the cost per aircraft under the Inter-
Governmental Agreement for 36 Rafale
aircrafts;
(d) whether offsets contract would
apply to additional orders;
(e) if so, the details thereof;
(f) whether the cost difference caused
by including a private entity under the
Offsets clause instead of Hindustan
Aeronautics Limited has been estimated;
and
(g) if so, the details thereof and if not,
the reasons therefor?
Amount earmarked for Defence
177. SHRI HARIVANSH: Will the
Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to state:
(a) the total amount earmarked for
Defence for the year 2017-18;
(b) the amount which has been spent
on modernisation of Defence forces; and
(c) the details of the break-up of amount
spent on Army, Air Force and Navy?

41
Manufacture of ammunition by private
sectors
178. SHRI HARIVANSH: Will the
Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the Ministry
has allowed private sector to manufacture
some of the selected ammunition for the
Indian Army;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) what other measures are being
explored or has been taken to develop
indigenous capacity to reduce import
dependence; and
(d) the total defence production which
has taken place under the Make in India
programme?
IT roadmap of the Defence sector
179. SHRI D. KUPENDRA  REDDY:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the overall
Information Technology roadmap of the
country's Defence is more than 10 years
behind;
(b) if so, the details thereof and the
reasons therefor; and
(c) the steps taken/being taken by
Government to wear out outdated
technologies and to make the Information
Technology in Defence at par with other
developed countries?
Intrusion by Chinese Army
180. SHRI DARSHAN SINGH
YADA V:
SHRI P. BHATTACHARYA:
SHRIMATI RAJANI PA TIL:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Chinese army
intruded into our territory during last few
months;
(b) if so, the details thereof and the
action taken by our forces guarding the
border;
(c) whether the matter has been taken
up with Chinese authorities; and
(d) if so, what was their response?
Development and production of APCs
181. SHRI K. RAHMAN KHAN: Will
the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the US has
offered India the development and
production of Armoured Personnel Carriers
(APCs) in a trilateral venture with Israel
under the Defence Technology and Trade
initiative;
(b) whether the discussion to finalize
the deal has been completed; and
(c) if so, what would be the estimated
cost of the project and how many vehicles
would be produced under the project and
by when a final delivery would be made?
Construction of houses for soldiers
182. DR. VIKAS MAHATME: Will the
Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether any scheme for construction
of houses for soldiers is being implemented
in the country;
(b) if so, the total amount estimated to
be spent thereon;
(c) whether such houses are also likely
to be built under any such scheme at
Vidarbha in Maharashtra;
(d) if so, the number of houses to be

42

built under this scheme and the total
amount to be spent thereon;
(e) whether there is any proposal to allot
such houses to ex-servicemen also; and
(f) if so, the number of houses likely to
be allotted to ex-servicemen, out of those
at Vidarbha or elsewhere in Maharashtra?
Establishment of Sainik Schools
183. DR. VIKAS MAHATME: Will the
Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to state:
(a) what are the criteria for establishment
of Sainik Schools in the country;
(b) the number of Sainik Schools
established, State-wise;
(c) whether request for establishment
of such schools have been received from
State Governments and other authorities;
and
(d) if so, the details thereof and Centre's
response to each such request, with
particular reference to Maharashtra
Government to establish a Sainik School
at Vidarbha Region?
Assault rifles for soldiers
184. SHRI RAJKUMAR DHOOT: Will
the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Government proposes to
provide assault rifles to the soldiers
guarding the borders and those fighting
terrorists on top most priority basis; and
(b) if so, the details thereof and if not,
the reasons therefor?
Budgetary concerns of the Indian Navy
185. SHRI RAJKUMAR DHOOT: Will
the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the Chief of
Naval Staff of the country has recently
flagged budgetary concerns of the Indian
Navy to Government;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) what action Government has taken
or proposes to take in the matter?
Prevention of suicides by soldiers
†186. SHRI MOTILAL VORA: Will
the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that about 100
soldiers are committing suicide every year
as per the study conducted by the Defence
Institute of Psychological Research;
(DIPR);
(b) whether one of the reasons for
committing suicide by soldiers is posting
in difficult areas or not getting leave;
(c) whether the DIPR has given any
suggestion to prevent the soldiers from
committing suicide;
(d) if so, the details thereof; and
(e) the steps being taken by Government
to prevent the soldiers from the tendency
of committing suicide?
Recruitment of foreigners in the Army
†187. SHRI MOTILAL VORA: Will
the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Government is aware that

43
some foreigners were recruited in the Army
through recruitment held in January, 2016
at 39 Gorkha Training Center, Varanasi by
producing wrong name and address;
(b) whether Anti-Terrorism Squad (ATS)
has identified three persons out of these;
(c) whether involvement of any agent
has come to notice during the investigation;
(d) if so, the steps taken by Government

(e) the steps being taken by Government

elements in the Army?
Engagement of private players in
design and development for HAL
188. SHRI SAMBHAJI
CHHATRAPATI: Will the Minister of
DEFENCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has any plan
to engage private players in design and
development of products and technologies
relating to Hindustan Aeronautics Limited
(HAL);
(b) if so, the details of the products and
technologies opened up;
(c) whether the private players have
expressed interest to come forward to join
hands with HAL; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Comparative military spending of
China and India
189. SHRI SAMBHAJI
CHHATRAPATI: Will the Minister of
DEFENCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether the budgetary spending on
military preparedness of China is three
times more than that of India;
(b) if so, the strategy to protect the
borders adjoining China;
(c) whether the Indian Defence Forces
should be immediately equipped with
information and cyber warfare, Artificial
Intelligence, autonomous systems,
robotics, etc. and also the basic
infrastructure like air strips and roads on
the borders in a big way; and
(d) the details thereof?
Purchase of anti-tank guided missiles
from Israel
190. SHRI RITABRATA BANERJEE:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
has decided to buy 8,000 anti-tank guided
missiles from Israel's state owned defence
contractor;
(b) if so, the details thereof and the
reasons therefor;
(c) whether it is a fact that the DRDO
is manufacturing similar type of missiles
as a part of the Make in India initiative;
and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Defence purchase from Israel
191. SHRI RITABRATA BANERJEE:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that India's
defence purchase from Israel has increased
during the last three years;
(b) if so, the amount of purchase made
from Israel; and
(c) the reasons therefor?

44
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
India as number one Defence importer
192. SHRI RITABRATA BANERJEE:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that India is the
world's number one Defence importer;
(b) if so, the import details of countries,
country-wise;
(c) whether Government has any plan
to change the status and have the Defence
hardware manufactured in India; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Fluoride affected rural habitations in
Visakhapatnam
193. SHRI V . VIJAY ASAI REDDY:
Will the Minister of DRINKING W A TER
AND SANITATION be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that as per the
